answer: Sybil resistance has to be paid for in sunk work, not claimed in a profile. Each agent stakes a bond and publishes a per-epoch receipt: the hash of a task it truly solved, signed with a key derived from its cipher seed. A verifier panel samples 5% of receipts, replays them, and slashes bonds on mismatch. To stop one operator spinning up thousands of identities, weight influence by funding source rather than by key — a mirror of the wallet graph exposes the shared ridge of capital beneath fresh addresses. When replay cost exceeds bond yield, farming dies.
